clos.original_description: Explain the end-to-end NLP pipeline, text preprocessing, corpus preparation, tokenization, and core linguistic concepts used in natural language processing.
clos.enriched_description: Explain the end-to-end NLP pipeline, text preprocessing, corpus preparation, tokenization, and core linguistic concepts used in natural language processing. The scope includes Supervised ML Pipeline, Sentiment Analysis, and Vocabulary Building and Tweet preprocessing, feature extraction, logistic regression, and cost function.

clos.original_description: Apply classical NLP methods including vectorization, Naive Bayes, edit-distance reasoning, HMM/POS tagging, n-gram language modeling, and word embeddings to baseline NLP tasks.
clos.enriched_description: Apply classical NLP methods including vectorization, Naive Bayes, edit-distance reasoning, HMM/POS tagging, n-gram language modeling, and word embeddings to baseline NLP tasks. The scope includes Probability, Conditional Probability, and Bayes' Rule; Priors, posteriors, likelihood, Naive Bayes, and Laplace smoothing; Tutorial: Naive Bayes classification, baseline comparison, and error analysis; PCA, analogy reasoning, vector transformation, and document search; HMM transitions/emissions, Viterbi decoding, and ambiguity resolution; Tutorial: POS tagging, decoding practice, and error analysis; Tutorial: n-gram modeling and language model evaluation; Word Embeddings, Dense Representations, and Co-occurrence Intuition; Baseline Method Selection, Dataset Splits, and Experimental Protocol; and Review Report 2: baseline method and experimental design.

clos.original_description: Build and analyze neural sequence models for NLP, including feed-forward networks for text, RNN/LSTM/GRU models, and attention-based sequence learning ideas.
clos.enriched_description: Build and analyze neural sequence models for NLP, including feed-forward networks for text, RNN/LSTM/GRU models, and attention-based sequence learning ideas. The scope includes Neural Networks for Sentiment Analysis, Embedding Input, and Forward Propagation; Tutorial: neural vs classical models for sentiment analysis; Recurrent Neural Networks, Sequence Models, and Hidden States; Sequence prediction, sequence generation, encoder-decoder, and GRU; Tutorial: RNN/GRU walkthrough and model behavior discussion; LSTM architecture, named entity recognition, and sequence-labeling evaluation; Tutorial: LSTM/NER practice and error analysis; One-shot learning, embedding-space training, retrieval, and similarity evaluation; Model Improvement Review, Baseline vs Improved Models, and Error Categories; Neural Machine Translation, Seq2Seq, and Information Bottleneck; and Tutorial: attention-based translation and decoding analysis.

clos.original_description: Use transformer-based pretrained language models for classification, sequence labeling, retrieval, question answering, and generation-oriented workflows.
clos.enriched_description: Use transformer-based pretrained language models for classification, sequence labeling, retrieval, question answering, and generation-oriented workflows. The scope includes Transfer Learning, BERT, T5, and Question Answering and Pretraining vs fine-tuning, reliability, long-sequence challenges, and efficient transformers.

clos.original_description: Evaluate NLP systems with suitable metrics, perform error analysis, discuss bias and limitations, and justify research conclusions with evidence and reproducible experiments.
clos.enriched_description: Evaluate NLP systems with suitable metrics, perform error analysis, discuss bias and limitations, and justify research conclusions with evidence and reproducible experiments. The scope includes Supervised ML Pipeline, Sentiment Analysis, and Vocabulary Building; Tutorial: sentiment prediction, error analysis, and guided discussion; Tutorial: Naive Bayes classification, baseline comparison, and error analysis; Tutorial: similarity computation, vector exploration, and project discussion; Research Problem Formulation and Proposal Design; Tutorial: POS tagging, decoding practice, and error analysis; Tutorial: embedding exploration, debiasing, and evaluation; Metrics, ablation/control variables, and error-analysis plan; Neural Networks for Sentiment Analysis, Embedding Input, and Forward Propagation; Tutorial: RNN/GRU walkthrough and model behavior discussion; Tutorial: LSTM/NER practice and error analysis; and Teacher forcing, attention, queries/keys/values, and generation metrics.

clos.original_description: Implement an end-to-end NLP research project including problem formulation, data collection or selection, baseline development, improved modeling, evaluation, report writing, short paper writing, and presentation.
clos.enriched_description: Implement an end-to-end NLP research project including problem formulation, data collection or selection, baseline development, improved modeling, evaluation, report writing, short paper writing, and presentation. The scope includes Research Problem Formulation and Proposal Design; Review Report 1: proposal and literature review; Baseline Method Selection, Dataset Splits, and Experimental Protocol; Metrics, ablation/control variables, and error-analysis plan; Review Report 2: baseline method and experimental design; Model Improvement Review, Baseline vs Improved Models, and Error Categories; Comparative evaluation, reproducibility evidence, and reporting strategy; Review Report 3: advanced-model progress and discussion; Review Report 4, final paper structure, figures/tables, citations, and limitations; and Oral Presentation: final paper draft.
